summary: The diff implements all acceptance criteria for REQ-13. The ProfileSetupModal was overhauled with inline error display, loading state on the submit button, input disabling during submission, and proper error surfacing. The useAuthFlow hook now treats both isFetched and isError as settled states so showProfileSetup activates for unregistered users. The useRegisterUser mutation immediately populates the query cache on success so the modal closes and the app transitions to ChatLayout without re-showing the setup modal. All six acceptance criteria appear to be addressed.
